We believe that reorganizing @Tesla's vehicle software deployment would greatly benefit owners worldwide. Let’s discuss this.

Many owners have misconceptions about the Standard and Advanced toggle in the Software tab in-vehicle, due to its unclear inclusion in each wave. Early Access Program participation has been largely ignored since its launch over a year ago.

Vehicles on older non-production branch software releases aren’t always prioritized, causing stagnation and exclusion from newer features and security fixes.

Tesla’s vehicle software is deployed on safety-critical products, so there’s always been an expectation of careful, closely monitored deployments. However, in conversations we’ve now had with 1,000+ owners this year, the resounding majority expressed an interest in cutting-edge access, even if that means requiring special care and attention.

As a software monitoring platform and an active account deeply engaged with the worldwide Tesla community, we observe these shared sentiments every day and want your voices to be heard.

We’ve built tools this year to communicate better and visualize upgrade paths between software updates, which 300,000+ vehicle owners have already used. We’ll continue to improve these experiences as best we can (including collaborating with other third-party platforms).

We’d love to know your thoughts on this and whether you’d like an option to access cutting-edge software + Full Self-Driving builds more consistently, with clearer communication about expected availability.

Our Membership page was temporarily inaccessible following this update. This has now been resolved and all impacted members have been directly contacted.

To be mindful of recent supply chain attacks within the developer community, we've also reduced the number of NPM packages used by the platform.

Several dependencies have been replaced with purpose-built implementations. These changes will be felt via performance boosts for all.

Signing in with X has been broken since December 2025; this has now been resolved. This now allows you to create an account and sign in solely with an X Account! 🎉

As with all OAuth providers (Google, Apple, X), we strongly encourage using Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).

Our web platform has been updated to V6.3.2, which now supports truly passwordless account creation with Google, Apple, or X accounts.

You can also create an account with just a Passkey (now standalone, instead of an alternative authentication option).

teslascope.com/blog/6.3.2

As far as we know, Teslascope is one of the only third-party Tesla apps with native support for Passkeys and has for over a year now.

We encourage all other apps to provide this experience for vehicle owners. 🔐
